title: Smart budgets design review
summary: The team streamlined the Smart Budgets onboarding from five to three steps, moving notifications to after the first week. They approved shipping the LLM categorizer at launch despite its $2 per 1,000 users monthly cost. Shared budgets were deferred to the Q1 roadmap with a data model change to support future owners, and an empty state for bank sync failures will be designed by Friday.
key_points: Current five-step onboarding causes a 40% drop at the bank connection step.
Merging goals and budget amounts into one step and auto‑suggesting amounts from the past 90 days.
LLM categorizer achieved 93% accuracy; cost is about $2 per thousand users per month.
Decision to ship the LLM categorizer for launch.
Adopt a three-step onboarding flow and defer notifications to after the first week.
Need an empty state for failed bank sync; Elena will deliver by Friday.
Shared budgets are out of scope for launch and will be added to the Q1 roadmap.
Data model will include an owner list to enable shared budgets later without migration.
Notification channel (push vs email) remains an open question.

decisions.decision: Adopt a three-step onboarding flow: welcome, connect bank, review suggested budgets; move notifications after the first week.
Ship the LLM categorizer for launch.
Exclude shared budgets from launch and schedule them for Q1 roadmap.
Implement budget table with an owner list to support shared budgets later without migration.

action_items.task: Design empty state that allows manual budget entry for bank sync failures
Add owner list field to budget table to support shared budgets
Add shared budgets to the product roadmap for Q1

open_questions: Which notification channels (push, email, or both) should be used for onboarding reminders?
